I couldn't find an Alberta poverty rate for people with disabilities, so I can't give you one.

The only Statistics Canada table that reports poverty by disability status is 11-10-0090-01, "Poverty and low-income statistics by disability status" (product ID 11100090). It covers 2013 to 2024 but reports **Canada only**. It has no provincial breakdown, so Alberta isn't in it. I also searched for other tables with disability and low-income data by province and found none.

I can pull the national rate for persons with disabilities aged 15 and over, using the Market Basket Measure (the official poverty line) or the Low Income Measure. It would be a Canada-wide figure, not an Alberta one. Alberta-specific estimates may exist in custom tabulations from Statistics Canada, or in Alberta government reports, but I haven't verified either.

Source: Statistics Canada, table 11-10-0090-01 (released 2026-04-29), dimension structure checked.
